name: Transmission Line
desc: A line of high-tension lattice pylons marching away to a vanishing point, catenary conductors sagging and travelling on the wind between them, insulator strings swinging and a slow aviation lamp breathing at each peak.

energy.doc: wind amplitude on the spans + lamp glow + approach rate

density.doc: how many braced bays are worked into each tower

speed.doc: how fast the line trucks past

n.doc: how many towers recede into the distance

x.doc: near tower base x as canvas fraction (the line recedes up-left from here)

y.doc: near tower base y as canvas fraction (ground line)

alpha.doc: overall opacity — drop it to sit the line further back in the haze

style.doc: aesthetic: galvanised lattice with rim light / pure dusk silhouette, no interior at all / cyan setting-out drawing / hatched engraved plate / infrared false-colour — the steel reads cool and the near conductors burn warm

seed.doc: deterministic seed for per-tower arm reach and dead lamps
